I'm poor (6 alashi), rivals have ~29-30. To win need influence for presidency (influence 1 each; holder is idx1 by tie_order). Getting influence 2 via bribe makes me president for law. Bribe 5 to idx1 gives them cash too — but presidency gives veto. But bribing idx1 makes richest richer. Bribe to idx2 keeps money with idx2 instead; either way I gain influence 2 > all others 1, so I become president regardless of recipient. Give bribe to idx1 (current holder) or idx2 — bribe idx2 to balance? Bribe idx1 makes them richer, worse for my rank; bribe idx2 (30.64M) makes them even richer. Both rich. Give to idx1 (28.82M, poorer) to balance. Choice 4.

But presidency value: veto control + possible commission 5%. Influence 2 also could win max influence commission later. Costs 5 alashi but I only have 6; that leaves 1 cash. Money devalues anyway (×0.62). Presidential control over laws could yield subsidy etc. I think bribe choice 4.
